_source: docs/POTATO_VOICE.md §16. Verbatim. One line per potato in the two hours after an edition prints. The File gets nothing for this.

any: The Bulletin's out. I've read it. You should.
New edition. Nothing about you in it. Yet.
The paper's out. Read it before the neighbor does.
morning: Morning edition. The Council has opinions again.
evening: Evening edition. The Count is in. I'm not saying.

any: New Bulletin. I'm mentioned. It isn't flattering.
The paper's out. Page one is us. Mostly you.
evening: Evening edition. I'm in it. Don't ask which part.
